name: Arrested man, Douglas, Arizona, November 2017 (silhouette only)
depiction: The 18-year-old Douglas, Arizona, resident Border Patrol agents took into custody on 29 November 2017 near marijuana bundles that had come over the border on a zip line (Border Patrol says).
